profile.headline: SWE, ML @ Stealth | prev @ Meta, Unity
profile.summary:
Hey! I'm a software/ML engineer and creative technologist based in SF, currently making platforms safer through multi-modal AI at Meta. I was previously at Unity, where I built AI-powered tools for 3D worldbuilding — GANs, diffusion models, and LLMs integrated directly into real-time editing workflows. On the side, I enjoy building games and playful, interactive experiences.
 
My interests lie at the intersection where computer vision, generative models, and spatial computing meet creative tools, games, and interactive applications. Feel free to reach out :)
